job.title: Senior Project Manager - Renewable Energy
job.description:
About the Company
  
We have partnered with an emerging leader in renewable energy across WA and NT, involved in remote power infrastructure, delivering complex microgrid and hybrid energy solutions across Australia’s most challenging environments.
With a strong focus on innovation, reliability, and practical engineering outcomes, the business designs and delivers end-to-end energy systems that support regional communities, industrial operations, and critical infrastructure. Their projects span solar, battery energy storage systems (BESS), diesel hybrid generation, and LV/HV electrical infrastructure.
  
As demand for off-grid and decentralized energy solutions continues to grow, the company is expanding its project delivery capability to support a strong pipeline of technically complex and high-impact projects.
  
About the Role
  
This is a senior delivery role for an experienced Project Manager based in Darwin. who thrives in complex, technically driven environments. You will take ownership of the end-to-end delivery of renewable energy and microgrid projects, leading multidisciplinary teams across engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning. This is a hands-on leadership position where you will be accountable for outcomes, not just oversight.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of renewable energy, microgrid, and hybrid power projects
  • Manage project scope, program, cost, risk, and performance reporting
  • Coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities
  • Oversee subcontractors and suppliers to ensure safe, compliant, and high-quality delivery
  • Manage project budgets, forecasts, variations, and commercial performance
  • Build strong relationships with clients, consultants, and key stakeholders
  • Work closely with engineering teams to resolve technical and delivery challenges
  • Support tendering, planning, and project development activities as required
  • Ensure strict adherence to HSEQ systems, standards, and procedures
  • Provide clear, accurate reporting to senior leadership on project performance
  
You will bring:
  
  • 5+ years experience as a Project manager managing subcontractors, budgets, schedules, and project risk
  • Proven experience in renewable energy, microgrids, solar, BESS, or electrical infrastructure projects
  • Tertiary qualification in Engineering, Project Management, Business or related discipline, with proven experience delivering complex projects or programs
  • Demonstrated project leadership across technical delivery, commercial management, and stakeholder engagement
  • Strong understanding of LV/HV systems and remote power generation
  • Strong commercial acumen including variations, cost control, and reporting
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Ability to lead delivery in fast-paced, technically complex environments
What’s on Offer
  • Opportunity to deliver complex and high-impact renewable energy projects across Australia
  • Strong pipeline of work in a rapidly growing sector
  • Hands-on leadership role with real ownership of project outcomes
  • Supportive team culture with strong technical capability
  • Exposure to cutting-edge microgrid and hybrid energy systems
If you’re looking for a role where you can take full ownership of delivery, work on technically challenging energy projects, and make a tangible impact, apply below or contact Kieran Mulholland on 0420 727 200

job.title: Retail Manager
job.description:
Retail Manager

Major Retail Asset | Darwin

Take the next step in your Centre Management career.

An outstanding opportunity has become available for an experienced Retail Manager to join the leadership team of a major retail asset in Darwin.
This is far more than a traditional retail operations position. Working closely with the Centre Manager and broader leadership team, you will play a key role in the strategic and commercial performance of the centre, gaining significant exposure across centre operations, financial performance, retailer relationships, business planning, capital projects and stakeholder management.

For the right person, this role represents an exceptional long-term career opportunity to step into greater Centre Management responsibility within a significant asset.

The Opportunity
You will take ownership of the day-to-day retail performance of the centre while becoming an increasingly influential member of the senior management team.
Your responsibilities will span:
  • Managing relationships with key and critical retailers, including performance, debt, lease matters and retailer negotiations
  • Monitoring and driving centre KPIs, retailer sales performance and precinct trends
  • Contributing to the annual business plan and broader asset strategy
  • Preparing and presenting key management and financial reports
  • Managing sales forecasts, turnover rent, budgets, abatements and other financial reporting
  • Working closely with Leasing to support leasing strategy and critical retailer reviews
  • Overseeing retailer engagement, tenancy delivery, refurbishments and shop openings
  • Taking a lead role in customer-facing capital works and projects
  • Working closely with Operations to resolve issues impacting retailer and centre performance
  • Maintaining a strong focus on centre presentation, standards and customer experience
  • Supporting emergency, risk and duty management responsibilities
  • Building strong relationships with retailers, stakeholders, community and industry representatives
  • Providing leadership, direction and support across the broader Centre Management team
A Role Designed for Career Progression!

This opportunity will suit an ambitious Centre Management professional who is ready to move beyond the traditional Retail Manager remit.
You will work closely with senior Centre Management, gain exposure to broader commercial and strategic decision-making, and have the opportunity to progressively take on greater responsibility across the asset.

The successful candidate will be someone who wants to be recognised as a future senior leader within the Centre Management environment, not simply someone looking for another Retail Manager position for the long-term.

About You
We are looking for an experienced retail property professional with:
  • 5+ years' experience within Centre Management (ideally)
  • A background as a Retail Manager, Operations Manager or Centre Manager of a smaller asset
  • Strong understanding of the retail property sector
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen
  • Experience managing key retailers and complex stakeholder relationships
  • Confidence interpreting financial, sales and performance data
  • Strong understanding of retail leasing and compliance
  • Demonstrated strategic and operational planning capability
  • Strong leadership and people-management skills
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills
  • A proactive, commercially focused approach to problem solving
  • A relevant tertiary qualification in Business, Property or a related discipline is desirable
Why This Opportunity?
This is an opportunity to join a high-profile retail asset and work alongside an experienced Centre Management leadership team while positioning yourself for the next stage of your career.

You will have genuine exposure to:
Commercial Strategy | Centre Performance | Financial Management | Retailer Relations | Leasing | Capital Projects | Business Planning | Leadership

If you are an experienced Retail Manager or Centre Management professional who is ready to broaden your responsibilities and position yourself for a significant future leadership opportunity, this is a role worth exploring.

Confidential enquiries are welcome.

Apply now or contact Jo Morrison on 0405 867 171 or joannew@foundationrec.com.au at Foundation Recruitment for a confidential discussion.

Its portfolio includes hospital refurbishments, health facility upgrades, building remediation, civil infrastructure, compliance works and complex upgrades within live operational environments.

The successful candidate will have strong commercial construction experience and take responsibility for day-to-day site delivery, working closely with Project Managers, subcontractors, trades, consultants and client stakeholders.

You will oversee site activities from mobilisation through to completion, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule and to the required quality standards.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Supervise day-to-day construction activities across hospital and healthcare projects.
  • Coordinate subcontractors, trades, suppliers and site resources.
  • Manage site sequencing, productivity, quality and project progress.
  • Ensure works comply with project plans, specifications, WHS requirements and healthcare standards.

The contractor is delivering a range of healthcare projects including hospital refurbishments, facility upgrades, critical infrastructure works, building remediation and compliance-driven improvements across Queensland.
The projects involve working within live healthcare environments requiring strong planning, stakeholder coordination and a high level of safety and quality control. The successful Site Supervisor will be responsible for maintaining programme, managing site interfaces and ensuring minimal disruption to hospital operations.

About You
The successful candidate will have:
  • Proven experience as a Site Supervisor, Site Manager or similar.
  • Experience delivering hospital, healthcare, commercial or government projects highly desirable.
  • Experience managing projects ranging from $5M–$25M.
  • Strong understanding of construction site operations and subcontractor management.
  • Ability to read and interpret drawings, specifications and project documentation.
  • Strong understanding of WHS, quality and environmental requirements.
  • Experience working within live operational environments.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • A practical, hands-on approach to problem solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality delivery.
Relevant trade, construction or site supervision qualifications will be highly regarded.

What Is Offered
  • Brisbane or Townsville-based opportunity with an established Tier 3 construction contractor.
  • Opportunity to work on major hospital and healthcare infrastructure projects.
  • 10 days on / 4 days off roster for regional projects, with flights provided.
  • Strong and growing project pipeline across Queensland.
  • Variety of construction, refurbishment, civil and facilities projects.
  • Opportunity to take ownership of site delivery.
  • Long-term career opportunity within a growing construction business.
